headline: An Inventor of Apple’s FaceID Wants to Analyze Your Brain’s Health With AI
context: Gidi Littwin’s new AI startup, Hemispheric, makes diagnostic brain scans for conditions like depression, PTSD, and Parkinson’s. He wants the technology to be as cheap and easy as for a blood test.
